entities.summary: People's Republic, a political institution in Cambodia during Khmer Rouge Genocide (1978–1979). Grew from Estimated 1.5–2 million Cambodians die from execution, starvation, and disease and Khmer Rouge captures Phnom Penh and begins forced evacuation of the entire city. Led to the emergence of PRK and Civil War.
